ownership_summary: Bayer 04 Leverkusen Fußball GmbH, which runs the professional team, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the chemicals and pharmaceuticals group Bayer AG; the club is one of the long-standing exceptions to the Bundesliga's 50+1 rule. A six-member shareholders' committee chaired by Werner Wenning oversees the GmbH.
